title: Two wardrobes

options.name: Two-door wardrobe
options.text: A two-door wardrobe in MDF on a plinth, with flat push to open doors. Inside: a shelf at the top, long hanging under it and two low shelves at the bottom.

poster.alt: 3D model of a two-door wardrobe with a top shelf, long hanging and two low shelves

options.name: Three-door wardrobe
options.text: A three-door wardrobe in MDF on a plinth, with flat push to open doors. On the left, behind one door, a tall run of shelves; on the right, behind two doors, a top shelf, long hanging and two low shelves.

poster.alt: 3D model of a three-door wardrobe with shelves on the left and hanging on the right

notes: The layout follows the sketch: one two-door wardrobe and one three-door wardrobe.
No sizes have been measured yet: the widths, the 2400 mm height and the 600 mm depth are standard sizes for now and will change to fit your room.
The heights inside (shelves, hanging and plinth) are standard and can move.
Doors are shown as push to open: tell me if you would prefer knobs or bar handles.
Colours on screen are a guide.
